updateMeasuredStock(id,expectedUpdateTime,currentStock,{operationId,direction}={}){check('inventory',id);const posting=direction==='post',quote=values.get('prep_quotes/'+operationId),op=values.get('prep_operations/'+operationId),source=posting?quote?.plan:op,effect=source?.effects?.find(row=>row.id===id),saved=values.get('inventory/'+id),token=operationId+'|'+direction+'|'+id;if(!measuredPrepId(operationId)||!['post','reverse'].includes(direction)||source?.version!==3||source.kind!=='measured-prep'||!effect||effect.delta===0||!saved||measuredWrites.has(token)||posting&&(quote.kind!=='measured-prep-quote'||!cache.has('prep_operations/'+operationId)||op)||!cache.has('prep_recovery_closures/'+operationId)||values.get('prep_recovery_closures/'+operationId)||saved.updateTime!==prepTimestampToken(expectedUpdateTime)||saved.branch!==effect.branch||saved.name!==effect.name||typeof currentStock!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(currentStock)||Math.abs(currentStock)>1e12||currentStock!==(posting?effect.afterStock:effect.beforeStock)||saved.currentStock!==(posting?effect.beforeStock:effect.afterStock)||prepTimestampToken(expectedUpdateTime)!==(posting?effect.beforeUpdateTime:op.createTime))throw Error('Only an exact nonzero measured movement or its guarded reversal may change stock.');measuredWrites.add(token);wrote=true;tx.update(db.doc('inventory/'+id),{currentStock});},

createMeasuredLog(id,value,{operationId,direction,index}={}){const source=direction==='post'?values.get('prep_quotes/'+operationId)?.plan:values.get('prep_operations/'+operationId),effect=source?.effects?.[index],posting=direction==='post',expectedId=(posting?'prep-':'prep-reverse-')+operationId+'-'+index;if(!measuredPrepId(operationId)||id!==expectedId||source?.version!==3||source.kind!=='measured-prep'||!effect||value.version!==3||value.kind!=='measured-prep-stock-log'||value.prepOperationId!==operationId||value.inventoryId!==effect.id||value.branch!==effect.branch||value.item!==effect.name||value.uom!==effect.unit||value.oldQty!==(posting?effect.beforeStock:effect.afterStock)||value.newQty!==(posting?effect.afterStock:effect.beforeStock)||value.variance!==(effect.delta===0?0:posting?effect.delta:-effect.delta)||effect.delta===0&&(effect.role!=='output'||source.outputWasWritten!==false)||!(value.actorType==='cashier'&&prepId(value.actorUid)&&prepId(value.staffId)&&prepId(value.deviceId)&&prepId(value.sessionId)||!posting&&value.user===OWNER))throw Error('Save only the exact measured movement log, including a proven zero-output observation.');wrote=true;tx.create(db.doc('stock_logs/'+id),value);},

createMeasuredStockWarning(id,value){const quote=values.get('prep_quotes/'+id);if(quote?.kind!=='measured-prep-quote'||value.sourceFingerprint!==quote.expectedFingerprint||value.warningFingerprint!==quote.warningFingerprint||value.stockPosted!==true||!validStockWarningRows(value.rows)||JSON.stringify(value.rows)!==JSON.stringify(measuredStockWarnings(quote.plan)))throw Error('Link the measured raw warning to its exact operation.');measuredCreate('prep_stock_warnings',id,value,'measured-prep-stock-warning');},
